scope: Contracts on extracted production Readings::get/is_fresh/clear_fresh/deliver and Inputs::latest/fresh, plus a checked first-matching-input lemma. No simulator source changes.
checked: Typed lookup uses the requested sensor name: absent data returns None, a successful cast returns that stored reading, and a failed cast returns an error.
Freshness lookup exactly matches the stored fresh-name set; clearing freshness preserves every stored reading.
Successful delivery replaces values under delivered names, retains every other reading, empties pending values, and unions delivered names into the fresh-name set.
Delivery errors preserve stored and pending values; freshness may be partially marked before an error.
Input access selects the first configured binding with the requested role; a missing role is an error. Missing sensor data returns None without falling back to truth.
Sensor samples preserve value, timestamp, and freshness. The fresh accessor suppresses stale samples.

Perfect-input access selects the configured measurement branch and current timestamp, with freshness true. State uses KinematicState; the existing other branch uses ContactList. Cast failures return errors.
trusted_boundaries: Creusot standard-library contracts, plus local BTreeMap lookup/append/clear/iteration and BTreeSet membership/insertion/clear specifications.
A restricted Iterator::find specification for callable, immutable, precise predicates; first-input selection over its returned prefix is proved.

Standard Any downcasts are opaque models. The reference-unsizing/downcast wrapper is trusted; it contains only the standard cast and downcast operation. Modelled cast success is not itself a type-system proof.
Any::type_id is unconstrained here: successful-delivery effects are proved, not complete detection of mismatched payload types or guaranteed delivery success.
Error-message construction is abstracted. Physical state and contact types come from ripple-core.
not_proved: Readings::publish: Creusot 0.14.0 panics in backend/resolve.rs:187 while handling replacement of owned Box<dyn Any + Send + Sync>. Publication is omitted, not assumed as a verified engine method.
Mission-time select_sources validation, including ruling out Perfect(Other).
PluginStack orchestration, arbitrary plugin callbacks, engine phase/clock ordering, or whole-program information-flow isolation through messages.
Correctness of estimator mathematics, sensor physics, or error-message text.
extraction: Actual production bodies are read by build.rs. Contracts, loop invariants, snapshots and proof assertions are inserted only into the proof copy.

Error construction is replaced without removing branch conditions or propagation. Perfect-reference coercion plus Any downcast is represented by one trusted wrapper because repeated dyn coercions have unrelated models in Creusot 0.14.0.
Extraction asserts the expected method set and exactly two perfect-reference conversions, one cast binding, one downcast replacement, and one delivery loop.

manual_wiring_review_not_formal_proof.crates/core/src/entity/plugin_stack.rs: start and estimate bind localization/tracking to their configured Inputs, update belief/contact outputs, and clear freshness. autonomy and controllers pass self.belief and KnownContacts over self.contacts. follow_perfect_state copies truth only for the configured perfect-state PassThrough path.
manual_wiring_review_not_formal_proof.crates/core/src/plugin.rs: AgentContext exposes state and known contacts rather than a truth field.
manual_wiring_review_not_formal_proof.crates/core/src/plugin/sensor.rs: SensorContext intentionally exposes truth to sensors; its reading store and sensor name are crate-private.
manual_wiring_review_not_formal_proof.qualification: Explicit perfect measurements intentionally originate in truth. Arbitrary messages are outside this access-path claim.
